messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=prod-inference (svc_82) — trigger=high-error-rate. Page routed to schedule 'oncall-rotation' at 03:14 UTC. target: team='eng-support' ; urgency=high :rotating_light:
Maya: Received multiple pages from contractors—they're not our SREs. :confused:
Kevin: I didn’t get a PD page. I was on-call for 'eng-sre' this shift.
Ben: Pagerduty noise - seeing repeated re-routes every 30s.
Sophia: Checking PD incident now. If the schedule mapping flipped we might be paging the wrong service binding.
oncall-pager: pd: incident INC-45231 created -> https://pagerduty.local/incidents/INC-45231 (auto)
Maya: Customers: two paying tenants reported 500s -> spike at 03:12 UTC. Support ticket numbers appended to incident.
Kevin: quick check — can someone run `pdctl incidents get INC-45231` and `pdctl schedules get oncall-rotation`?
Zach: I grabbed the schedule output, looks like the rotation metadata was changed at 03:10 by service-syncer. user=svc-syncer@infra, change_id=chg_778
ops-bot: change detected: schedule binding for 'prod-inference' -> 'eng-support' (was 'eng-sre')
Ben: ohhh, that explains contractors getting pages. We have an automated sync job that applies a YAML map from the onboarding repo. Might have a stale mapping.
Sophia: I'm on PD -> reassigning incident to 'eng-sre' and stopping outgoing reroute. Doing manual override now. :eyes:
Maya: Ack that — I see manual override in UI. Can someone ack the page so contractors stop receiving it?
Kevin: acked — Kevin (eng-sre) :white_check_mark:
Maya: Confirmed contractors are no longer getting pages.
Ben: Customer impact: roughly 3% of production requests 500/timeout from 03:12 to 03:24 UTC (~12 minutes). Two tenant accounts saw errors and retry load spiked.
Sophia: Mitigation steps: 1) Manual PD rebind to correct schedule (done). 2) Disable syncer job `service-schedule-syncer` and roll it back to v1.2.3. 3) Re-run mapping validator against onboarding repo.
Kevin: I ran a quick grep on the repo: `git show origin/main:infra/oncall.yaml | grep prod-inference` — found mapping to eng-support introduced in commit `a1b2c3` at 02:58 UTC.
Maya: Who approved that commit? We need audit trail.
Zach: commit was auto-merged by onboard-bot after stale branch policy, author=thirdparty-infra, pr=382. That bot recently started auto-approve for external infra changes.
Ben: That's the problem. We need a stopgap — disable auto-merge for oncall files immediately. I'll open an org-wide PR to revert the auto-approve rule.
Sophia: For now, setting incident severity to Sev2 (customer impact, partial) and adding postmortem owners: Maya, Ben, Kevin.
Maya: Noting timeline in incident: root cause = schedule syncer applied incorrect mapping from onboarding repo; secondary cause = auto-merge setting allowed external infra change without human review.
Kevin: Action items (short):
- Ben: disable auto-approve and create revert PR (INFR-459)
- Zach: rollback service-schedule-syncer to pinned version and restart with `systemctl restart service-schedule-syncer`
- Sophia: validate PD bindings + run smoke test for prod-inference (3 endpoints)
- Maya: draft customer-facing status blurb and update support tickets

Ben: done — auto-approve disabled rule and opened revert PR: https://git.internal/r/PR-389 (will request SRE review).
Zach: rolled back the syncer to v1.2.3 and restarted at 03:28 UTC. Logs show no further schedule writes.
Sophia: smoke tests: all endpoints OK at 03:34 UTC. No further 500s reported in monitoring graphs.
Maya: Customers notified via support at 03:36 UTC. Summary: brief outage window ~12m, degraded 3% requests, resolved by manual PD rebind + syncer rollback.
Kevin: Will follow up in postmortem, assigning to RLW-3123. Please add links to PD incident and revert PR in the postmortem.
ops-bot: Created follow-up ticket: RLW-3123 (postmortem), linked to INC-45231 and PR-389.
Maya: Quick retrospec: add a validation step in the syncer so schedule changes require a `validated: true` flag in the YAML or a manual approval for changes to prod bindings.
Ben: Agreed. I'll draft the change and include a unit test for mapping diffs.
Sophia: Any outstanding pages? I show none.
Maya: Closing thread for now. If anything else pops up, reopen. Thanks all. :pray:
